title: Draw a square
prompt: The robot draws by driving. `forward` prints "forward 30" and `left` prints "left", and both already exist. Make `solve` drive a square: forward then left, four times over, for eight instructions in total.

tests.name: Eight instructions: forward, left, four times

hints: A square is the same corner four times.
Write that pair four times in solve, eight lines in all.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.

solution:
func solve():
	forward()
	left()
	forward()
	left()
	forward()
	left()
	forward()
	left()

func forward():
	print("forward 30")

func left():
	print("left")
